description: Antigravity CLI (agy) 1.5.9 skills.json declaration manifest sample (<workspace>/.agents/skills.json). Same schema as plugins.json/rules.json/agents.json: entries[] paths are scanned one level deep; workspace-relative paths must stay inside the workspace or repository root (absolute/../symlink entries are skipped by the untrusted-repository protection); inherits[] merges other manifests. Verified on the remote 1.5.9 machine: a declared non-standard directory's skills appear in the /skills panel labeled '<dir> · From <project>' and as slash commands.
